title: Carrot Cake (Chai Tow Kway)
description: Carrot Cake (Chai Tow Kway) is a dish from Singapore prepared with daikon, rice flour, chicken egg, garlic. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Pickled daikon replaces traditionally preserved radish. The dish is a savory daikon-rice cake, not a carrot dessert.

steps.instruction: Peel and coarsely grate the listed vegetables; squeeze out excess moisture so the mixture will hold together.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Steam the radish-rice-flour batter in a shallow greased tray until firm, cool until sliceable, then cube for stir-frying.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 18 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
